description_expanded: **$50 gift card for all guests booked to stay 5+ nights May 23- Aug 7!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - 4 Seater Golf Cart included** (A $200/day savings!!- Available to guests who sign liability waiver. A quick bike ride in the other direction and you can enjoy a Seagrove staple, Old Florida Fish House as well as great fishing, paddle boarding, and kayaking along Eastern Lake. 12/31/2035 3 $175 $1225 $5250 Reviews One of the Best! What an amazing stay! This is a beautifully decorated home and the owners have thought of every detail to ensure a perfect stay. The house is so spacious for a large family and is easily accessible to the beach by bike, walk, or golf cart that comes with the rental. We love taking strolls to restaurants and shops with the kids. The kitchen and gathering areas were plenty big to accommodate our family and offered top of the line appliances for cooking. We thoroughly enjoyed the cozy patio to gather for lots of laughter. We could not have found a better place to stay and we will absolutely be back in May. Ivan & Toya Longshore Mar 2024 Feeling all the after Christmas Beach Vibes this was our family’s second time staying at Beach Vibes and it did not disappoint! We went for a quick getaway right after Christmas Day. This townhouse is so nicely decorated and modern and lots of space- the kids of course love the bunk bed room! The house includes a golf cart which is a really nice touch and perfect to cruise around to all the places that 30A has to offer! But even without the cart- my husband and I took a nice walk to the beach. And we walked right down the street to our favorite hangout and restaurant “Old FLorida Fishhouse”. Such a great trip! Will definitely be back again and again! Kimberly Camp Jan 2024 Great location! We loved this townhouse, great location; right in the middle of 30A; 3min away from Old Florida Fish House, 8 minutes away from The Big Chill, 10 m away from Rosemary’ and 10min away from Seaside. Really comfortable and clean. Mariana Cubero Jan 2024 Write a ReviewYour email address will not be published.
